coordinateAuthority.worldFrame: EPSG:26916 registered terrain; x east, y up, z south; metres
coordinateAuthority.placementRule: The exact August 2024 Street View panorama is projected into EPSG:26916 and snapped to ODOT road feature 3019609. That official-road point is the registration basis, not the building site. The west-side private drive terminates at Austen's 2026-08-29 orthophoto-traced lower-loop junction. The provisional gatehouse site is derived from that loop segment's centroid-facing interior normal so its footprint remains behind the road.

sourceReference.storagePolicy: Reference imagery is inspected in the ordinary Google Maps viewer and is not copied into the repository. Only authored simulation frames are stored.

registration.evidenceRule: Exact panorama metadata plus the identifiable west-side private-drive junction in the registered 2023 NAIP raster. No colored diagnostic overlay is source evidence.

driveway.surface: pale compacted gravel private-drive throat terminating at the lower-loop junction

fence.sourceConfidence: street-view-observed layout aligned to the official road tangent

views.label: Direct entrance / front

sourceView.method: Exact August 2024 panorama pose; heading is clockwise from true north per the Google Maps URL contract.

expectedScreenRegions: gatehouse and porch in the center-right third
broad gravel drive across the lower center
clean fence break framing both sides of the drive
road paint crossing the foreground with the west-side entrance beyond it
baselineDiscrepancies: No gatehouse, porch, vending machine, fence, gate sign, utility poles, wires, or road paint existed.
The player avatar and EUC dominated the capture instead of a locked road-facing composition.
Overlapping path ribbons formed an abstract angular junction rather than a gravel apron meeting a country road.

views.label: Road-right approach
expectedScreenRegions: gatehouse low in the left third
gate sign and driveway break near center
tall utility pole and overhead wires near center-right
long white fence run and road continuing through the right third
baselineDiscrepancies: The current scene read as a generic field without the long fence or utility rhythm.
The public road lacked white edge lines and double yellow center lines.
No modest building mass anchored the drive entrance.

views.label: Road-left approach

sourceView.method: Verified panorama rotated left to study the opposite fence run, drive break, and gatehouse offset.

expectedScreenRegions: white fence run leading toward the entrance
drive break and pale apron centered
gatehouse offset beyond the opening rather than blocking it
open lawn and mature deciduous canopy behind
baselineDiscrepancies: The drive break could not be read because no fence established its edges.
The existing path ribbons did not resolve into a road-to-apron-to-private-drive sequence.

views.label: Gatehouse detail

sourceView.method: Direct entrance angle zoomed to the porch frontage.

expectedScreenRegions: low white gable and porch structure across the upper half
two dark front windows and central door
red Coca-Cola vending machine on the right frontage
gate sign and gravel texture retained as secondary context
baselineDiscrepancies: No close-range architectural or brand-color anchor existed.
The scene had no porch depth, frontage rhythm, or human-scale entrance detail.
